channel.title: Bharat Naukri Alert — Latest Sarkari Updates
channel.description: Scholarships, exams, jobs aur sarkari schemes ke rozana updates with official links.

item.title: PSSSB Craft Instructor Admit Card 2026 Out
item.description: The PSSSB Craft Instructor Admit Card 2026 has been released on October 3, 2026, by the Subordinate Services Selection Board, Punjab (PSSSB) for 681 Craft Instructor (ITI Instructor) posts. The written examination is scheduled from October 6 to 13, 2026

item.title: Punjab Courts Clerk Recruitment 2026
item.description: Recruitment for 1270 Clerk positions in the Subordinate Courts of Punjab. Requires a Bachelor's degree, 10th with Punjabi, and computer proficiency. Selection involves a CBT and Computer Proficiency Test

item.title: SAIL CMLO Young Professionals Recruitment 2026
item.description: SAIL CMLO is recruiting 4 Young Professionals (Civil Engineer, Surveyor, IT Engineer, Electronics Engineer). Candidates with B.E/B.Tech or MCA and relevant post-qualification experience, aged 35-42, can apply via email by October 22, 2026. Salary ranges from Rs. 70,000/- to Rs. 1,40,000/- per month

item.title: IBPS Clerk CRP CSA-XVI Recruitment 2026
item.description: IBPS has released a recruitment notification for Customer Service Associate (CSA) / Clerical Cadre positions in various public sector banks. Eligible graduates can apply online for 11663 vacancies. The application period is from August 1, 2026, to August 28, 2026

item.title: Railway RRB Technician Recruitment 2026
item.description: Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs) has released CEN No. 02/2026 for Technician Grade-I Signal and Technician Grade-III posts across Zonal Railways and Production Units. A total of 6,557 vacancies are available. Online applications are invited from eligible Indian citizens

item.title: PSSSB Punjab Craft Instructor Recruitment 2026
item.description: PSSSB has reopened applications for 681 Craft Instructor / ITI Instructor posts in the Department of Technical Education and Industrial Training, Govt of Punjab. Eligible candidates with Degree, Diploma, or ITI in relevant trades can apply online. Age limit is 18-37 years

item.title: JKSSB Junior Health Inspector & Technician Admit Card 2026
item.description: Admit cards released for JKSSB Junior Health Inspector (FW) and Technician G-II (Lab Group and Medical Group) posts under Notification No. 07 of 2025. The OMR-based written exam is scheduled for 6 and 7 October 2026. Download hall tickets from jkssb.nic.in

item.title: ITBP Constable GD Sports Quota Recruitment 2026
item.description: ITBPF invites online applications from eligible male and female Indian citizens for 126 vacancies of Constable (General Duty) under Sports Quota 2025. Candidates must be matriculation pass and have represented State/Country in recognized sports competitions. Age limit is 18-23 years

item.title: One Time Registration (OTR) for National Scholarship Portal
item.description: The National Scholarship Portal (NSP) has introduced a One Time Registration (OTR) process to simplify the scholarship application procedure for students across India

item.title: RGCB Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026
item.description: Recruitment 2026 for 1 post of Junior Research Fellow. Candidates Can Apply Online. The last date to apply online is 14-10-2026. The candidate shall apply online through RGCB official website

item.title: UPSSSC Livestock Extension Officer Recruitment 2026
item.description: UPSSSC is recruiting 1251 Livestock Extension Officers. Candidates with a valid UPSSSC PET 2025 scorecard, Class 12 with Biology, and a two-year Pashudhan Prasar Diploma can apply. The application process closes on September 29, 2026

item.title: North Western Railway Apprentice Recruitment 2026
item.description: North Western Railway is inviting applications for 2,008 Apprentice positions. Selection is based on a merit list derived from Class 10 and ITI marks. Registration opens October 7, 2026

item.title: JKSSB Class 4 MTS and Sanitation Worker Recruitment 2026
item.description: JKSSB has released a recruitment notification (Advt. No. 09 of 2026) for 2,863 vacancies of Class-IV (Multi-Tasking Staff – MTS) and Sanitation Worker positions. Eligible permanent residents/domicile holders of J&K can apply online from Oct 14, 2026 to Nov 12, 2026

item.title: DSSSB Recruitment 2022 for 547 Posts
item.description: DSSSB is inviting applications for 547 vacancies including TGT, PGT, Manager, Accountant, and other posts. The application process starts on July 28, 2022, and ends on August 27, 2022

item.title: RRC Kharagpur PET Result 2026
item.description: The Railway Recruitment Cell (RRC), Kharagpur has published the Physical Efficiency Test (PET) result for CEN No. RRC-08/2024. The PET was conducted on 30 September 2026 at SERSA Stadium, Kharagpur. Lists of 243 qualified and 115 not qualified candidates are available

item.title: MSCE Pune Scholarship 2026
item.description: MSCE Pune Scholarship 2026 for 4th and 7th standard students in Maharashtra. Application deadline extended to February 13, 2026, with regular fee. Aadhaar is mandatory for students, and schools need an 11-digit UDISE code to register

item.description: Railway Recruitment Cell, North Western Railway invites online applications for 2008 Act Apprentice positions across various divisions and workshops. Selection is based on a merit list of Class 10th and ITI marks

item.title: LIC Golden Jubilee Scholarship Scheme 2026-27
item.description: The LIC Golden Jubilee Scholarship 2026-27 is a financial assistance scheme for meritorious students from economically weaker families. It supports higher education in medical, engineering, graduation, diploma, vocational, and ITI programs. Applicants must meet academic and family income criteria

item.title: Rajasthan Village Development Officer (VDO) Recruitment 2025
item.description: Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB) invites online applications for Village Development Officer (VDO) posts. Candidates need a Bachelor's Degree and a NIELIT O Level Exam Pass or equivalent computer qualification. Total 850 vacancies available

item.title: PSSSB Jail Warder and Matron Result 2026
item.description: PSSSB has declared the Punjab Jail Warder and Matron Result 2026 for Advt 08/2026 on 30 September 2026. The result covers the written exam held on 26 July 2026 for 532 posts (475 Warder Male, 57 Matron Female) in the Punjab Prisons Department. Shortlisted candidates will proceed to the Physical Test

item.title: UPSSSC Platoon Commander / Block Organizer Eligibility Result 2026
item.description: The UPSSSC has released the Eligibility Result for 295 Platoon Commander and Block Organizer posts (Advt. No. 10-Exam/2026) on October 1, 2026. Candidates can check the result PDF on upsssc.gov.in and prepare for the Main Written Examination

item.title: UPSSSC Havildar Instructor Eligibility Result 2026
item.description: UPSSSC has released the Havildar Instructor Eligibility Result 2026, shortlisting 10,025 candidates based on PET 2025 normalized scores for the Main Exam. This is a shortlisting result for 209 Havildar Instructor posts, not the final selection. Candidates can check the result on upsssc.gov.in

item.title: UPSSSC Enforcement Constable Final Result 2026 Out
item.description: The Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has declared the Enforcement Constable (Pravartan Sipahi) Final Result 2026 on 30 September 2026 for 477 posts. Candidates can check the result PDF on the official website upsssc.gov.in

item.title: DSSSB Delhi High Court Attendant Result 2026
item.description: DSSSB has released the Delhi High Court Attendant Result 2026 for Court Attendant, Room Attendant and Security Attendant posts under Advt No. 03/2025. Candidates can check their results on the official DSSSB portal. Total 334 vacancies were announced for these posts

item.description: IBPS PO Mains Admit Card 2026 released on September 24, 2026, for the Mains exam scheduled on October 4, 2026. Candidates can download their call letter from ibps.in using registration number and date of birth for 7,565 Probationary Officer/Management Trainee vacancies

item.title: UPPSC Health Education Officer Admit Card 2026
item.description: Admit cards released for the UPPSC Health Education Officer (Swasthya Shiksha Adhikari) Screening Examination-2025, scheduled for October 4, 2026. Candidates can download their hall tickets from uppsc.up.nic.in for the 221 available posts

item.description: The National Means cum Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS) 2026 offers Rs 12,000 annually to one lakh students from government, government-aided, or local body schools. Applicants must have parental income under Rs 3.5 lakh and at least 55% in Class VII. Apply on NSP by September 30, 2026
